statements.quote: We should increase in the R&D spend and next quarter we will guide R&D next year. That will be our expected R&D spend for next year.
More on the overall performance of FY23 to '25, there has been almost 13% to 14% CAGR in EBITDA as well as earnings, even if I adjust for the milestones income.
Next year it will just be part of our core operating OPEX to support these and the rest of our innovative medicines business.
statements.target: ~US$100M incremental launch spend folded into core opex FY27

statements.quote: Our ETR has moved up from around 13% to 15% to currently about 25% and that is the reason why you would see that the PAT improvement may not be commensurate with the margin improvement.
We have indicated in the past that… for acquisition, if it is necessary, we are comfortable in raising debt.
The milestone income… may or may not recur in the future, hence, you may treat it as one-off income.
statements.target: US$55M milestone (Q3 FY26) – not to be annualised

statements.quote: We do not guide on revenue growth for specific businesses.
statements.target: None – explicit refusal to guide segment growth
